probes.check: am_probe_fastgltf_assets(): loading a sample glTF with an external buffer reads exactly two files, both through the assets interface.

seeded_violation.description: Let fastgltf load external buffers itself with Options::LoadExternalBuffers.

probes.check: am_probe_fastgltf_assets(): loading the sample twice gives the same meshes, nodes, accessors and buffer bytes.

seeded_violation.description: Name each unnamed mesh after its address, so tools can tell meshes apart.

adaptation_notes: am_fastgltf_load() reads the glTF or GLB file through the assets interface into a GltfDataBuffer, parses it without Options::LoadExternalBuffers, so fastgltf opens no file itself, then reads each buffer with a relative URI through the interface into a sources::Array.
Images keep their sources::URI: the image decoder loads them through the interface when the game asks.
The parser takes the extensions the game passes; extensions and options change what an import produces, so a cooker records them with its output.
